sections.description: Vilpy plugin voor beheer van WordPress websites.
sections.installation: Upload de plugin, activeer hem en configureer de gewenste Vilpy-instellingen.
sections.changelog:
0.0.74

Added a login screen background color setting. When a color is set it is used as the login background and the background image is hidden.

0.0.73

Login page now respects the configured client logo size setting instead of a fixed width, and the login screen is fully responsive on mobile.

0.0.72

Changed the Vilpy login slug to use a controlled passthrough to native wp-login.php instead of rendering it internally, preventing white screens on custom login slugs.

0.0.71

Fixed a recursive custom login URL filter that could still break the Vilpy login slug flow.

0.0.70

Hardened the custom login slug routing and validation to prevent white screens when replacing wp-admin/wp-login with a Vilpy slug.

0.0.69

Replaced both plugin banner assets with the new update plugin artwork.
